summary.text: Denise Roberts is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 25, appointed in December 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Roberts earned a bachelor's degree in radio, television, film and communications from Howard University and a master's degree in public relations, advertising and applied communications from American University.

She has been communications director of the Office of the State's Attorney of Prince George's County since 2018, and previously worked in communications for Prince George's County government from 2005 to 2018.
The Prince George's County Democratic Central Committee appointed her to the House of Delegates on December 28, 2023, to replace Nick Charles, and she assumed office on January 8, 2024.
